scientific_integrity: Proof and standalone exact finite checks are supplied. General Eulerian and Markov-type methods are acknowledged as prior work; no independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Directed cyclic length-two reads on three labeled symbols only; no homopolymers, no errors or missing reads, rotation equivalence without reversal. Novelty relative to an unlocated exact specialization remains a bibliographic risk. Finite experiments corroborate but do not prove the infinite result.
title: Loopless ternary cyclic digram profiles: exact capacity and complete singleton classification
